introHtml: Paper personal care items offer a sustainable alternative for brands looking to reduce plastic waste without sacrificing functionality. From affirmation cards that boost morale to mini paper bags for sample kits, paper products provide a natural, recyclable surface for full-color printing. Ideal for trade shows, wellness programs, or hotel amenities, these items combine eco-friendliness with practical use. Choose paper for a softer, more tactile brand experience that aligns with green initiatives.
